faqs.q: What services does Dallas Detox Center offer?
faqs.a: Dallas Detox Center offers medical detox, residential inpatient care, and dual-diagnosis mental health treatment. Our luxury Texas rehab facility provides 24/7 medical supervision and personalized recovery plans to help individuals safely overcome drug and alcohol addiction.

faqs.q: What makes your Dallas drug and alcohol rehab different?
faqs.a: Our luxury center treats addiction and underlying mental health issues like depression or anxiety at the same time. We offer a private campus with private and semi-private rooms, flat-screen TVs, device access, and unique treatments like equine therapy, art therapy, and music therapy.

faqs.q: Can I use FMLA to protect my job while in rehab at Dallas Detox Center?
faqs.a: Yes, you can use the Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) to protect your job and take unpaid, job-protected leave for substance abuse treatment. Our admissions and case management teams will help you complete all the required FMLA paperwork safely and confidentially.

faqs.q: Who can get help at your Texas recovery center?
faqs.a: We offer specialized, individual recovery programs for adults from all walks of life. Our campus features targeted treatment tracks designed specifically for professionals, veterans, first responders, and college students who need a safe place to heal.

faqs.q: What does the full admissions process look like from the first call?
faqs.a: Your journey begins with a confidential phone call where our admissions team guides you through a free medical screening and insurance check. If our Dallas program is a fit, we can arrange same-day travel to our private estate, where our medical team will welcome you, complete your physical evaluation, and help you comfortably settle into your suite.

faqs.q: Does Dallas Detox Center accept health insurance?
faqs.a: Yes, we work with most major insurance plans to help cover the cost of your recovery. Our team provides free insurance verification to check your benefits and minimize your out-of-pocket costs before you arrive.
